scripts.build: npm run types && npm run prepare:assets && tsc --noEmit && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.ci: npm run types && npm run prepare:assets && npm run validate && npm test && tsc --noEmit && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.prepare:assets: npm run calc:data && npm run content:index && npm run suggest && npm run redirects && npm run content:sync
scripts.deploy:build: npm run types && npm run prepare:assets && npm run validate && npm test && tsc --noEmit && npm run search:index && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply venoms-search --remote && npm run seed:version
scripts.db:seed: npm run prepare:assets && npm run search:index && node scripts/seed-version.mjs --local --promote
scripts.setup:local: npm run types && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
